scope: Theorem 2.5 (Uniform phase and forbidden range) of the manuscript “The critical correlation exponent of the planar XY model” (preprints/The-critical-correlation-exponent-of-the-planar-XY-model-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e58587be77cd0256), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every b > 0, a(b) = 0 or a(b) ≥ 8π. If a(b) > 0, the fractional mean ⟨h, um⟩ mod 2π converges to uniform measure on the circle, independently of any fixed finite collection of the Gaussian observations of Theorem 2.4. More generally, for a fixed nonzero integer l and any zero-total profiles tm of bounded reference cost, wm(lum + tm) −→ 0. (2.9)
